theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers show the strongest durability_bar (0.64) and breadth (0.643) among the top eligible themes, while remaining rank 2 at 1.55 with a trendish mixed Hurst tag. The absolute-trend gate (validated risk control) keeps this theme eligible through drawdowns, and its cohesion is the most robust signal available in a detector where momentum rank is not predictive. Lean favors the more durable, higher-breadth theme over the marginal leader.

The mean-revert tag is the core reason to lean away from overweight: in a theme whose own trend-health marker suggests decay, directionality is weak. This is NOT a fade call — only a relative underweight against a more durable eligible peer.
theses.dissent: It is the confirmed leader and headline theme, and leadership can persist beyond a single mean-revert read; copper has a strong macro-industrial narrative that may dominate for quarters.

theses.dissent: Defensive yield and renewables have structural policy support; if unscheduled macro surprises (0.4 share) turn risk-off, utilities could hold better than cyclical leaders.
